s: Additionally, an allegation or perception that we have not taken sufficient action in these areas could negatively harm our reputation. ​ The growing use of AI systems to automate processes, analyze data, and support decision-making poses inherent risks. ​ Flaws, biases, or malfunctions in systems powered by AI could lead to operational disruptions, data loss, or erroneous decision-making, that may impact business operations, financial condition, and reputation.
Ethical and legal challenges may arise, including biases or discrimination in AI outcomes, non-compliance with data protection regulations, and lack of transparency.

Furthermore, the deployment of AI systems could expose the Company to increased cybersecurity threats, such as data breaches and unauthorized access leading to financial losses, legal liabilities, and reputational damage.

The Company also faces competitive risks if it fails to adopt AI or other machine learning technologies in a timely fashion. ​ Risks Related to Intellectual Property ​ We cannot be certain that our patent strategy will be effective in protecting against competition. ​ Our commercial success depends in large part on obtaining and maintaining patent, trademark, and trade secret protection of our human or animal products, both prescription and non-prescription, our current human or animal product candidates and any future human or animal product candidates, and their respective components, formulations, methods used to manufacture them and methods of treatment, as well as successfully defending our patents and other intellectual property rights against third-party challenges.
